[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: Build & finalize Sítio Torres (N-06-66) FDA FSVP site-visit record + reusable EXIF-safe PDF image pipeline
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/fda_fsvp/pull/22
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/fda_fsvp/pull/23
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/fda_fsvp/pull/24
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/fda_fsvp/pull/26
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/fda_fsvp/pull/27
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/fda_fsvp/pull/29
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/fda_fsvp/pull/30
  
  Details:
  Built, corrected, and finalized the FDA FSVP supplier site-visit record for Sítio Torres (CoopCao, Pacajá/PA), 2026-09-09, in TrueSightDAO/fda_fsvp, plus a reusable image-embedding helper that fixes a class of photo-orientation defects across all future site-visit documents.
  
  Scope of work (one PR per turn):
  - PR #22 — created the Sítio Torres farm site-visit record (2026-09-09, FDA FSVP), 6-page template.
  - PR #23 — finalized site code N-06-66 (confirmed with CEPOTX).
  - PR #24 — fixed p5 photo caption (IMG_9682 = cacao plant growth) after Grok-vision verification.
  - PR #26 — corrected Facility B/C labeling: one shared covered processing structure (fermentation vessels inside; same structure used for drying); applied 11 label/description edits and relocated IMG_9673 to Facility C.
  - PR #27 — root-caused and fixed an EXIF-orientation defect (Apple HEIC→JPEG export leaves a stale Orientation tag while pixels are already upright; the ad-hoc converter applied exif_transpose to upright pixels and forced every image into a fixed landscape box → rotated/squashed photos). Added tools/site_visit_images.py (prepare_for_pdf/img_flow): embeds pixels as-is, preserves aspect on downscale, strips EXIF; documented the rule in README.md as a standing rule for all site-visit PDFs; rebuilt the Sítio Torres PDF with all six frames aspect-correct.
  - PR #29 — added the Facility A reference/representative image (IMG_9622, correct-farm frame) to the previously image-less Facility A block; screened photo batches for EXIF/GPS farm provenance to avoid embedding another farm's photo into an FSVP record.
  - PR #30 — reordered evidence photos: moved the last evidence photo (cacao plant growth, IMG_9682) to be the first, preserving the 6-page layout and all captions.
  
  Verification: each PR rebuilt the PDF locally and verified page count, per-page image counts, caption reading order, and rendered orientation (Grok-vision on rendered pages). No production deploy; no ledger/money action.
  
  Deliverable is final on fda_fsvp main. Each revision was logged with a companion revision markdown capturing the rationale.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 0
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
